features_at_horizon_2_or_more: without treasury_settlement and treasury_settlement_coupons (the risk dates are then the three calendar types)
calibration: none: the parent's risk-date forecast (none: fitted on risk-date label days only and exactly 0 on every other day), changed by one thing: a ridge logistic on spread_bps, sofr_p75_iorb_bps and sofr_p99_iorb_bps serves every day that is not a risk date; then the 'persist' false-alarm control on the days that are not risk dates: on a day that is not a risk date the forecast is the smaller of the component's probability today and the variant's forecast on the previous scored day (the parent's, if that was a risk date); metadata/risk_date_false_alarm_controls.json
